training_data_provenance.generation_method: 145 + 0.14*month_index + annual and semiannual sinusoidal components + seeded Normal(0, 3.5) noise; rounded and floored at zero

target_description: Synthetic illustrative monthly invoice-volume count; not an approved NOP target.

feature_definitions.year: Calendar year of the prediction month.
feature_definitions.quarter: Calendar quarter of the prediction month.
feature_definitions.month_01..month_12: One-hot indicators for the prediction month-of-year.
feature_definitions.lag_1, lag_3, lag_6, lag_12: Observed or recursively predicted counts 1, 3, 6 and 12 months before the prediction month.

training_configuration.holdout_strategy: recursive forecast from final training month for the entire holdout horizon
training_configuration.deployment_refit: After holdout evaluation, refit the serialized estimator on all available supervised observations; holdout metrics remain from the pre-holdout estimator.

evaluation_metrics.prediction_policy: recursive; holdout targets are never fed into later holdout features

baseline_comparison.definition: First forecast repeats the final training count; each later forecast repeats the previous baseline prediction.

known_limitations: Trained and evaluated exclusively on reproducible synthetic data; metrics do not estimate NOP business performance.
Synthetic counts do not encode NOP source scope, invoice lifecycle, holidays, reporting lag, operational changes or business meaning.
Only calendar and lagged counts are used; no exogenous business drivers are included.
Recursive forecast errors may compound over longer horizons; no prediction intervals are provided.
A supplied history replaces the bundled synthetic history at inference but is not validated or approved by this model package.
